<!-- Generated by tools/make_data.py from the same definitions as the Dictionary tab. Don't edit. -->

| | Column | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | **Production Date** | The day the lot was knitted. June 1 to August 28, 2022. The source's description says 2023; the data says 2022. |
| B | **Lot** | The factory's lot (order) number. The same lot can appear more than once on a day. |
| C | **Machine** | Knitting machine brand. Brand only: the table doesn't identify the individual machine. |
| D | **Machine Diameter (in)** | Diameter of the circular knitting machine, in inches.  |
| E | **Machine Gauge (needles/in)** | Machine gauge, in needles per inch.  |
| F | **Construction** | Knit structure, as a code. See the construction codes below. |
| G | **Composition (as recorded)** | Fiber content, typed by hand in the report. Hundreds of spellings for the same blends, plus blanks. |
| H | **Yarn Count (as recorded)** | The yarns used, in the factory's notation. Mixed notation; see below. Stored as text. |
| I | **Stitch Length (mm)** | Loop (stitch) length of the main yarn, in millimeters.  |
| J | **Fabric Diameter (in)** | Finished fabric diameter or width, in inches. Some rows say "any" instead of a number. |
| K | **GSM (g/m2)** | Fabric weight, in grams per square meter.  |
| L | **Production Qty (kg)** | Amount knitted for this row, all shifts, in kilograms. The source doesn't state the unit; the factory's own note (see Reject Qty) says kg. |
| M | **Reject Qty** | Amount rejected; the unit isn't stated. Many rows are blank: no rejects, or not recorded? One row holds a note instead of a number. |

### Construction codes {#codes}

| Code | Means |
| --- | --- |
| `S/J` | Single jersey |
| `LS/J` | Lycra (elastane) single jersey |
| `Rib` | Rib, including flat-knit collars and cuffs |
| `Fleece_terry` | Fleece and French terry |
| `Mesh` | Mesh |
| `Pique` | Pique |
| `Interlock` | Interlock |
| `other` | Anything else |

### Yarn count notation {#yarn}

| Written | Means |
| --- | --- |
| `30/1` | Cotton count (Ne) 30, single yarn: higher numbers are finer |
| `20/D` | 20 denier, usually elastane |
| `75D/72F` | 75 denier, 72 filaments: a filament yarn, usually polyester |
| `34/1,20/D` | Two yarns knitted together, separated by a comma |
